entities.summary: Victoria, a notable figure in the history of India, associated with British Raj (1858–1920). Preceded by Crown Rule and Nationalist Movement and Indian National Congress. Their legacy influenced Quit India Movement and Gandhi's Salt March galvanizes the Indian independence movement.
